body:
## Context

The release audit's mechanical baseline is RED solely because of this: packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs ("no documentation file in the repo still claims exit 0 when there is nothing to check", :158) walks EVERY .md/.mdx under the repo root with no tracked-file filter (:68-95). The untracked audit report release-blockers.md QUOTES the stale claim verbatim while describing the (already fixed) bug, and the NOTHING_TO_CHECK ∧ CLAIMS_PASS heuristic (:102-103) cannot tell a doc that makes the claim from a doc that quotes it. No shipped doc is wrong; the suite is red because an operator-local scratch file sits in the walk — and every future release-audit run will re-redden the suite the same way.

## What to change

`packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` — restrict docFiles to git-tracked files (`git ls-files -z -- '*.md' '*.mdx'` from the repo root), keeping the existing directory walk as the fallback when git is unavailable or the root is not a work tree (tarball/consumer context). Keep the nested-checkout skip (:80-86) for the fallback path. Add a tracked-vs-untracked test mirroring the nested-checkout scaffold (:139-157): mkdtemp + git init; plant an offender UNTRACKED (not scanned) then track it (scanned).

## Acceptance criteria

1. Tracked-vs-untracked behavior is pinned by a test. verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` exits 0 with the new test present.
2. The suite is green in THIS repo with an untracked offender present at root. verify: from the repo root with release-blockers.md untracked (git status --porcelain shows '?? release-blockers.md'), `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0.
3. A TRACKED doc making the stale claim still fails the scan (the gate did not go inert). verify: the new test's tracked case asserts detection; `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: spec-lint: doc-claim scan reads only git-tracked docs — an untracked operator report must not redden the suite
